notes: **Presenter:** Joshua. One person, one list, in video order.

**Before recording anything:** Joshua has a Qube login in Chrome on his own laptop. Everything is typed into Qube itself (no Claude, no terminal). Close anything that shows an email, account name, API key or notification. Someone else holds the phone for the over-the-shoulder and laptop shots.

**Shoot order (one real 15-minute run):** A1 spinner shot → start the A2 timer → A3 montage → A4 → A5 → A6 → A2 end shot (straight after the result appears) → A7 → A8 → A0 talking takes. The challenge is real: Joshua builds and tests inside the 15 minutes the timer shows.

**The strategy Joshua types** (on screen only, never spoken): his own, fresh, made up on the day inside the 15 minutes. Not J020's 10-stock test (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA… buy on a 3% drop, $2,000 a trade, sell at +3% or −5%): that result is already in J020. His real result on the day is the video's result (producer's call, Oct 27).

open.text: **Line 8.** The original's "that's me" line ("I don't even know what candlesticks are") isn't true for Joshua, who runs a trading platform, so line 8 does the same job fresh: "And that's with zero code. I literally just typed what I wanted."
**The result is Joshua's own run on the day** (producer's call): no dollar figure is spoken, lines 5 and 7 land on what's on screen. The A9 inset is built from his result.png once he sends it.
**The timer at the end** only comes back if Joshua really finishes inside 15 minutes (A2 end shot).

**CTA strength.** Her "my non-trading guru workflow" names a mystery offer; ours can only promise the free sign-up link (`cta-and-offer`, Mark Oct 23), same as J026. Your call if you want it stronger.

rows.how: **Read at the original's speed, about 4 words a second: quick, no pauses between lines. Aim for the whole video at about 46s.** 1. Turn the laptop around so its screen and keyboard face the phone. 2. Phone vertical (9:16) on the desk about 50cm in front of the laptop, at the height of the top of the lid, office lights on, lock focus and exposure. 3. Joshua sits behind the laptop, chin resting just over the top of the lid, one hand reaching around to the trackpad. **CHECK: the spinner (A1) and the countdown (A2) must be readable on the laptop screen in the phone's frame.** 4. **Opening shot** (with A1 open and paused on the laptop): chin over the top of the laptop, pouting at camera, finger on the trackpad. Say to camera: "Trying a new side hustle everyday until I make 100 K a month." On "month", tap the trackpad to play the spinner. You can't see the screen from behind the lid, so don't wait to see it land. From the tap, count about 4.5 seconds (3s of fast blur plus 1.5s of slowing, A1 step 3), then look up and say "Trading?". If someone is behind the phone, they raise a hand out of frame the moment TRADING stops. 3 takes. **CHECK: watch take 1 back. The look-up must come as the spinner stops, not before it. If it's early or late, change the count before take 2.** 5. **Timer shot** (with A2 on the laptop, laptop turned to face the phone, as in step 1, filmed in the same position so the countdown is in frame under his face): "All right, we got 15 minutes on the timer. Let's see if I can cook." 2 takes. 6. **Close-ups** (phone moved in, face fills the frame), 3 takes each: "Hold up. This might be the move." (one hand up on "Hold up") · "My turn. Let's backtest mine before time's up. Go." 7. **Reaction**, 3 takes, big: "Bro, are you kidding me? That's what my strategy would've done. Wins, losses, all of it." (mouth open, lean back) then "And that's with zero code. I literally just typed what I wanted." (shake the head). 8. **CTA**, yellow pen in hand, 3 takes: "Wanna try it yourself? Comment QUBE and I'll send you the link for the free sign-up."

rows.how: 1. Log in to Qube in the same Chrome window (zoom 125%). 2. Start a new strategy by describing it in plain English. 3. Phone filming the laptop screen as in A4. 4. Type your own strategy by hand, in plain English, like a text (don't paste). Say all six things: what you'd watch (which stocks or what market), when you'd buy, how much goes in each trade, when you'd sell (up how much from where you bought, or down how much), how much you start with, and the dates to test it on. **CHECK: it must not be J020's test (the 10 biggest US stocks, buy on a 3% drop, $2,000 a trade, sell at +3% or −5%). Pick different stocks or a different rule.** 5. The pen tip follows the text as it's typed. 6. Send it, and keep filming until Qube has written the strategy. Hold 2s. 7. Also take a laptop screenshot of the typed sentence (typed.png) as a backup.

rows.file: J033_A6_backtest.mp4 · 1080×1920 · up to 60s · plus J033_A6_run.mp4, J033_A6_result.png, J033_A6_trades.png
rows.how: 1. Phone filming the laptop screen as in A4. 2. Pen taps the backtest button. 3. **Run shot:** film again from over Joshua's shoulder as his finger presses run (3s, 2 takes). 4. Keep filming until the result appears. 5. Hold 3s on the result. 6. Laptop screenshot of the result with the final value readable (result.png). 7. Open the list of every trade. Scroll top to bottom in about 3s, then stop where at least 3 red losing trades are on screen together. Pen points at one red trade. Hold 3s. 8. Screenshot that spot (trades.png). 9. Go straight to the A2 end shot. **CHECK: whatever Qube shows is the result, gain or loss. Use it as it is; don't re-run or tweak the strategy to get a better number, and never change a number. result.png must show the start value, the end value, the gain or loss, the test period, the number of trades and the worst drop. Send result.png to Mark the same day.** **CHECK: "Backtest, not live results" goes on every frame of this in the edit.** **CHECK: the trade list must show real losing trades in red.**
rows.what: The backtest: pressing run, the result, every trade

Phone vertical, from the side as in A3. Joshua at the laptop, tapping the yellow pen on the desk, eyes on the screen, for about 1s in silence, then says "Okay, it's done. I'm scared to look." and covers his eyes with one hand. 4s, 2 takes. **CHECK: nothing readable on the laptop screen.**

1. Crop Joshua's A6 result.png (his own run on the day) to the final value and its gain or loss, 600px wide, 16px rounded corners, dark border #0B0F14. 2. Place it top-left, 60px from the top and left edges, like the original's balance inset. 3. Under it, on-screen text, 2 lines: main line: the start value → the end value · the gain or loss, copied exactly from result.png (Inter Bold 44px, white; a gain in green #22C55E, a loss in red #EF4444) · small line: `Backtest, not live results`, then the test period, the number of trades and the worst drop from result.png, separated by " · " (if his stocks are today's biggest companies, add `today's biggest stocks, so some hindsight`) (Inter Bold 26px, light grey #9AA3AE, wraps to 3 lines, max 600px wide). 4. Pops in on "Bro" (scale 80→100% in 0.15s), holds to the end of the line. **CHECK: every number in the text must be on the crop of result.png, and none of J020's ($18,147, +$8,147, 607 trades, −$3,207) unless his screen really shows it. If they don't match, stop and tell Mark.**
